body:
Tell me your entire personality using only one of these three chips. I'll go first — mine is feral about a bridge, no contest, every single time 🤍

They're three of the starter chips on Mood, and the other two in this set are just as devastating:
— plotting something in a ball gown
— winning, quietly

Here's what Mood actually does: you tap the one that's you today, and it pulls the Taylor songs that match the exact feeling you picked — not a generic playlist, the specific ones that fit the mood.

Send this to the friend who is SO obviously 'plotting something in a ball gown' and make them admit it.

Photo: Taylor in 2007 — Brian Cantoni (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons.

tap Mood on longlivets.com/?mode=mood&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=mood
mediaCredit: Brian Cantoni (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
altText: Taylor Swift in 2007, seated with an acoustic guitar, long curly blonde hair, smiling at the camera.
why: 09-23 Mood beat, mood:chip-poll, September slot 2 of 2 (the last September chance; Mood has never shipped a post). Three chips quoted VERBATIM from apps/web/lib/longlive/mood-starters.ts: 'feral about a bridge', 'plotting something in a ball gown', 'winning, quietly' — all map to SCORED eras (Red/All Too Well, reputation, Lover/1989); none touch evermore/Midnights/TTPD/TLOAS (unscored). This is chip-poll, so NO specific returned songs are asserted (that's the October mood:result format) — safe against the unscored-era trap. Deep link /?mode=mood verified in code (packages/experience/src/deepLink.ts:34, MODE_VALUES includes 'mood' -> {kind:'mode',mode:'mood'}); caption also says 'tap Mood' as belt-and-suspenders. Share hook (required on mood): genuine tag-a-friend grounded in a specific chip. Hook: direct address; first-6-words distinct from the X sibling and recent posts. PHOTO: debut-acoustic-2007, decorative, NO era-relevance claim (credited plainly as 'Taylor in 2007'), photoEra unset (mood:chip-poll is not a themed family). FORCED L001 CONFLICT: after the 09-22 pair consumed both Lover photos, ALL 10 library photos have been used within 6 days — no photo is >=7 days clear, so L001's spacing cannot be met, and its written remedy (drop X to text-only) is checker-blocked (X hard-requires media, check-drafts.mjs:577). Per the checker's own 'a finite library cannot deadlock the calendar' design, I selected the two least-recently-used distinct photos (IG debut 6d, X reputation 5d) rather than blank Mood's last September slot; strict L001 would blank the entire remaining fortnight by the same arithmetic. Structural deadlock tracked in #3733 (open, unanswered). Photo-only (no mood-feature.png slide 2): cannot verify it shows Mood mid-use, so per 'cool feature only' I dropped the slide rather than ship an unverified screenshot.

critique.rationale: A 'which one are you' poll on three real Mood chips, opened first-person with a genuine tag-a-friend share hook. Promotes Mood — never once shipped in this desk's history — and shows what it does: tap a chip, get the Taylor songs that match the feeling you picked.
